description: Type the 403 the snapshot read operations answer on an organization without the early access: {"status": 403, "error": "FORBIDDEN: early access API endpoint"}. The spec types it only as the shared envelope, so it surfaced as the generic Forbidden, which is also what a missing permission answers. Observed live 2026-11-12 on GET /v1/organizations/{organizationId}/services/{serviceId}/snapshots, .../snapshots/{snapshotId} and .../snapshotConfiguration, and on PATCH .../snapshotConfiguration (49221856-ffc3-40e3-8fa7-2e84d9adbb3b).

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The feature is not available to this organization or service: its plan does not include it, it is not enabled for the organization, or it is not set up. The message says which.
